Base MulAdd UGEN_NAME Constuctor (without "mul" or "add"), use the AR() and KR() versions in user code.

This uses the "expanding" version of MulAdd which is generally used for random-based UGen classes (e.g., WhiteNoise). This is "expanding" in the sense that multiple channels of the Base UGen are generated depending on the number of channels in the "mul" and/or "add" inputs. Construct and return an audio rate UGEN_NAME adding "mul" and/or "add" operations as necessary. A "mul" operation will not be added if the multiplier is 1.0, an "add" operation will not be added if the "add" value is 0.0.

DOCS

Returns:
The audio rate UGEN_NAME. Construct and return a control rate UGEN_NAME (if available, otherise returns an audio version by default). A "mul" operation will not be added if the multiplier is 1.0, an "add" operation will not be added if the "add" value is 0.0.

DOCS
The control rate UGEN_NAME. Construct and return an audio rate UGEN_NAME (SC compatability). A "mul" operation will not be added if the multiplier is 1.0, an "add" operation will not be added if the "add" value is 0.0.

DOCS
The audio rate UGEN_NAME. Construct and return a control rate UGEN_NAME (SC compatability). A "mul" operation will not be added if the multiplier is 1.0, an "add" operation will not be added if the "add" value is 0.0.

DOCS
The control rate UGEN_NAME. Declare a UGen with multiply and add inputs. This uses the "direct" version of MulAdd which is generally used for non randomly-based UGen classes. It assumes that multiple channels generated by multiple channels of "mul" and/or "add" would differ only by these scale and offset values (i.e., the channels are otherwise the same "shape" which is unintuitive in the case of noise since one would expect each channel of noise to be fundamentally different).
Parameters:
UGEN_NAME Name of the UGen to create, this wiil derive from UGen
ARGS_CALL A comma separated list of the arguments the constructor takes when called. NB this excludes the mul and add arguments. This must be surrounded by parentheses. E.g., 

 (freq, phase)
ARGS_CALL_MULADD A comma separated list of the arguments the ar/kr/AR/KR methods take when called. This must be surrounded by parentheses. Commonly this should be the same as ARGS_CALL with the mul and add args added. You can use MulAdd_ArgsCall for this e.g., 

 (freq, phase, MulAdd_ArgsCall)
ARGS_DECLARE A comma separated list of the arguments the constructor takes when declared. NB this excludes the mul and add arguments. Each of these parameters must have a default. This must be surrounded by parentheses. E.g., 

 (UGen const& freq = 440.f, UGen const& phase = 0.f)
ARGS_DECLARE_MULADD A comma separated list of the arguments the ar/kr/AR/KR methods take when declared. Each of these parameters must have a default. This must be surrounded by parentheses. Commonly this should be the same as ARGS_CALL with the mul and add args added. You can use MulAdd_ArgsDeclare for this e.g., 

 (UGen const& freq = 440.f, UGen const& phase = 0.f, MulAdd_ArgsDeclare)
DOCS Doxygen "param" documentation usually from a define. You can simply use DEFAULT_UGEN_DOCS or COMMON_UGEN_DOCS if you wish. Most UGen classes use COMMON_UGEN_DOCS followed by their own param documentation followed by the MulAdd param documentation.
E.g., 

 COMMON_UGEN_DOCS MyUGen_Docs MulAddArgs_Docs


  • note these are separated by spaces so they form a single item.
